title: Separation property/material return - historical practice and current control
summary: Historical separation cases show HR checking/retrieving employee work items at departure, while the current 2025 handbook explicitly requires return of RTEC materials, copies, summaries and notes at termination.

claims.claim: Historical separation records show HR/management checking the employee's workspace for RTEC property and work records at departure and, in a driver case, collecting or arranging return of items such as name tag, paperwork and uniforms.

evidence.page_or_section: restricted 2013 separation records - generalized property-return pattern
evidence.note: Employee identities and case reasons excluded.

claims.claim: The current December 15, 2025 handbook requires an employee whose employment terminates for any reason to return RTEC materials and all copies, summaries and notes without retaining copies.
The combined evidence supports a separation control that distinguishes company property/material return from the reason for separation and documents completion even when there is nothing to return.

trigger: Employee separates from RTEC for any reason.
prerequisites: Identify assigned RTEC property, records, uniforms/credentials and access relevant to the employee's role.
steps: Identify RTEC property/materials/access assigned to the employee.
Retrieve required physical property, records, copies, notes and role-specific items.
Document items returned and explicitly record when no company property is outstanding.
Complete access/record-return steps under the governing offboarding process.
decisions: Which role-specific items/access must be returned or disabled.
deadlines: At or before separation where practicable.
controls: Do not infer separation reason from the property-return checklist.
Current handbook confidentiality/material-return requirement governs over historical case examples.
Record 'none outstanding' rather than leaving the control ambiguous.
unresolved_questions: What is the current complete offboarding checklist for uniforms, keys, badges/name tags, devices, records, system access and final timekeeping?
Which roles own each offboarding step and how is completion verified?
automation_candidates: Role-based offboarding checklist populated from asset/access inventory.
Require explicit returned/not-applicable/outstanding status for each assigned item.
Block case closure until outstanding company property/access exceptions are resolved or formally waived.
